## What changed

<!-- one paragraph -->

## Change class

- [ ] Editorial — label, note, typo
- [ ] Additive — new class, attribute or scenario
- [ ] Semantic — domain or range change, re-parenting, validity interval
- [ ] Breaking — retire, merge, split, URI change

## Provenance

| Assertion | Source URL | Retrieved | Tier |
|---|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |  |

Tier: 1 authoritative machine-readable · 2 authoritative unstructured ·
3 bank-published · 4 secondary.

## Checks

- [ ] `make gate` passes
- [ ] `make model artefacts viewer` run and committed if the model changed
- [ ] Every new assertion carries a source URL and a retrieval date
- [ ] Confidence set explicitly — nothing self-promoted to `validated`
- [ ] No scenario deleted to make a gate pass
- [ ] Structural findings resolved, not suppressed
- [ ] No credentials, consent-bound data or redistributed bank documents

## Obligation impact

- [ ] This touches an obligation, licence, prudential reference or validity interval

If ticked, this cannot auto-merge and needs a Domain Steward, and a review board
if breaking.
